similar_problems: Late blight; Septoria leaf spot; bacterial spot
diagnostic_difference: Early blight has target-like concentric rings on lower leaves; late blight has rapidly expanding water-soaked lesions and white growth; bacterial spots lack concentric rings.

similar_problems: Early blight; frost/chemical injury; bacterial wilt
diagnostic_difference: Late blight expands rapidly with wet dark lesions and white underside growth; early blight has dry target rings; bacterial wilt causes wilt without foliar blight lesions.
